title: fix(app-shell): offer the 变更 chip only when the reader's audit read answers

domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUR8Nu4M7tbtgES7q2

Fixes #30344

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：记录页「动态」的「变更」筛选，以及活动面板下拉里的「字段变更」选项，只在当前读者对审计日志的读取成功之后才出现；读取被拒（403）或失败时都不出现，与关闭字段历史时一样。
- 为什么改：没有审计日志读权限的销售打开开启了字段历史的线索，点「变更」永远是空的，会误以为「没人改过这条记录」或筛选坏了。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端两处判断（记录页一处、活动面板下拉一处，共用同一条规则），不加请求、不让页面等待；能读的用户在审计读取返回后才看到「变更」；没有宿主声明时下拉照旧四项。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 中 `fieldHistoryShown` 与审计读取 `.catch`；`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` 中 `getFilterOptions` 与 `activeFilter`；两个测试文件的新用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx`，预期全过（未修复时 403 用例多出 `changes`，下拉用例多出 Field Changes）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`RecordDetailView` told the timeline stream whether the record shows its field history (`RecordFieldHistoryContext`, which decides the 变更 chip) from `historyEnabled` alone: `enable.trackHistory` plus whether `sys_audit_log` is registered. It never asked whether this reader's audit read answered. A member the server refuses that read to got a 变更 chip that always filtered to nothing.

Now the context carries `fieldHistoryShown = historyEnabled && historyEntries !== null`:

- The audit read's `.catch` (a refusal, or any other failure) now leaves `historyEntries` at `null` instead of `[]`. `null` is what the code already means by "no answer" (`timelineFieldChanges` documents it so), and the stream merges `null` and `[]` the same way, so no row changes.
- So the chip is offered only once the read has answered, and a refused read draws no chip, as history off does (ruling C on #30074 is unchanged).

**The panel dropdown.** `RecordActivityTimeline`'s filter dropdown (the panel face, `getFilterOptions`) now reads `RecordFieldHistoryContext` and offers `changes_only` exactly when `timelineStreamFilters(fieldHistory)` offers the stream's `changes` chip. It reuses the stream's rule instead of adding a second one. The context's default stays `true`, so a host with no provider keeps all four options. A chosen or controlled `changes_only` that is no longer offered reads as `all`, the way the stream's chips fall back.

**Why this shape (no wait).** Nothing waits on the audit read. `historyEnabled` still gates the read itself (`historyPage` / `historyWanted`, so the read still goes out only when the stream is on screen) and still asks the page payload's `timeline.fieldChanges`. Only the chip waits: on the 动态 tab it joins the other three chips when the read answers. Two other shapes were considered and not taken:
- Hide the chip on a refusal only, and offer it while the read is pending. A refused reader then sees the chip appear and disappear, and a failed (5xx) read still offers an always-empty chip. The card asks for "offered only when this reader's audit read succeeds".
- Hold the 动态 tab until the read lands. That makes the page wait, which the code today avoids.

**The 动态 count.** No change is needed. With a payload, the server counts each source as the caller does (`record-page-routes.ts` `answerTimeline`: "a refused ledger count is no field change"), and with zero field changes it keeps the `updated` activity rows. On the client, `mergeTimelineStream` also keeps `updated` rows when there are no field changes. Without a payload, the stream counts its own rows. Either way, a refused read counts no field change.

## Tests

One new case in the shared harness `RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678.test.tsx`, in the existing #30074 `describe` (the harness rule: a new pin goes into the component's shared harness file):

- `a reader whose audit read is refused (403): no 变更 chip, as with history off`. The `sys_audit_log` read rejects in the client's shape (`httpStatus: 403`, `code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED'`). The case waits for the read to go out and settle, then asserts the chips are exactly `all / activity / discussion`.
- Positive control: the existing `trackHistory` case now asserts the four chips after the read has answered (zero rows): history on and readable keeps 变更.
- The existing history-off case is unchanged: no 变更, and no audit read.

- New top-level describe in the stream harness `recordTimelineStream-27055.test.tsx`: "the panel's `changes_only` is offered by the same rule as the 变更 chip". It covers four cases. History shown offers four options. History not shown offers no Field Changes. No provider offers four options (control). A `changes_only` that is not offered reads as All Activity and every entry draws. A history-shown `changes_only` control still filters to the field change only.

## Acceptance notes

- The panel dropdown was first left out because it was outside the claimed surface. The seat's amendment 6657436301 widened the surface, and this PR now carries the dropdown too.
- A failed (non-refusal) audit read now withholds the chip too, since it also answers nothing. The read is not retried. This is unchanged from before, when it showed an empty 变更.
